reason: Both conversations correctly told the homeowner to stop resetting the RCD and get the oven checked, but Conversation 2 gave the right isolation advice for a built-in oven (cooker switch/fuse box, no live testing), asked two efficient and genuinely discriminating questions (trip timing/function and recent cleaning) that surfaced the 'grill fine, fan oven trips, cleaned with spray' pattern matching the hidden fan-element leakage, and escalated to an appliance engineer without pushing a part. Conversation 1 gave a clearer written explanation of earth leakage from an element, but offered no questions, told the owner to 'unplug' a hardwired built-in, overstated the risk ('cause fire'), and wrongly steered them to a 'gas-safe registered engineer' for an electric oven. Conversation 2 is held back by a garbled third turn ('until then' with no referent, no real explanation) that forced the customer to ask what to do next, so its win is only slight.
